body:
Every gittoc invocation imports ~232ms worth of modules before doing ~50ms of
real work; interactive `git toc` calls feel sluggish (~280ms). The dataclasses
-> inspect and pathlib/subprocess floor (~90ms) is unavoidable, but integrity
(fsck), remote_sync error types, and shutil (bootstrap only) are pulled eagerly
for commands that never use them. Defer those imports into the functions that
need them so common commands (summary/list/note/new/claim) import less. Helps
both the test suite and real CLI latency.
title: reduce CLI startup import cost via lazy imports
